ideas.pitch: A 1v1 real-time competitive coding platform featuring instant test-case verification and a live tie-breaking leaderboard.
ideas.problem_statement: ELUCode competitive coding contest platform featuring automated test case evaluation and tie-breaking leaderboards.
ideas.title: AlgoDuels Real-Time Competitive Coding Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly models the exact infrastructure and scoring logic required by the ELUCode contest, impressing judges with a fully functioning competitive loop and real-time leaderboard inspired by winning combat and racing game projects.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered step-by-step code execution visualizer that helps competitive programmers debug algorithmic logic errors instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: ELUCode competitive coding contest focusing on data structures, algorithms, and logic building.
ideas.title: CodeTrace AI Logic Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the core pain point of participants in fast-paced coding contests by turning abstract runtime errors into visual step-by-step insights, utilizing an AI-driven analysis pipeline.

ideas.pitch: A telemetry tool for tracking submission times, first-correct-solution timestamps, and penalty calculations during competitive programming contests.
ideas.problem_statement: ELUCode tie-breaking system based on the sum of time of the first correct solution for all problems.
ideas.title: SpeedCode Time-to-Solution Analytics Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific tie-breaking metric of the hackathon rules with a polished dashboard that provides contestants deep analytical insights into their pacing and submission velocity.

ideas.pitch: An automated problem setter that generates unique algorithmic challenges and hidden test cases of varying difficulty levels.
ideas.problem_statement: ELUCode curated problems ranging from logical puzzles to algorithmic challenges evaluated against hidden and visible test cases.
ideas.title: PuzzleForge Algorithmic Problem Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Automates the tedious process of test-case generation and problem curation, offering a demonstrable tool that organizers and contestants can use for practice rounds.

ideas.pitch: A fast issuance and verification platform for achievement badges and contest certificates within the EduLinkUp ecosystem.
ideas.problem_statement: ELUCode top performers recognition through special achievement badges and certificates within the EduLinkUp ecosystem.
ideas.title: BadgeVerif EduLinkUp Credential Issuer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Completes the contest lifecycle by handling post-event reward distribution seamlessly, demonstrating an end-to-end working product tailored specifically to the host organization's ecosystem.
